This block sits 8 to 5 weeks out from the national qualifier, so it is a prepeak-specificity build block rather than a peak. Snatch and Clean and Jerk stay in on all 5 lifting days, Front Squat stays in twice weekly to hold leg strength under the lifts, and Back Squat plus the midweek Olympic-pull slot stay on maintenance so more readiness goes to the classic lifts.

Weeks 2 and 3 only nudge bar weight up on the classic lifts when the prior week stayed clean at or under the RPE cap. Front Squat, Back Squat, and the midweek Olympic-pull slot stay flat on purpose; Week 4 keeps the Week 3 main-lift loads but trims back-off and accessory volume so you finish the block fresher for the next runway segment.

Do your normal wrist prep before every rack day. If the left wrist moves past mild awareness or the rack gets unstable, hold the last pain-free Clean and Jerk or Front Squat load, remove one set from that front-rack exercise, and keep the non-rack pulling work and rows; do not force extra rack volume on a noisy day.

Mon	Snatch	95 kg	5	1	2-3 min	7.5-8	~85-88% lane across this block. If >RPE 8 or any miss, stay at the last made weight and cut 1 set.	
Mon	Clean and Jerk	121 kg	4	1	3 min	7.5-8	~86-89% lane across this block. If rack or jerk line degrades, hold load and finish only crisp singles.	
Mon	Front Squat	135 kg	4	2	3 min	7-7.5	~82% of 165. Held stable on purpose to protect the lifts; if >RPE 7.5, keep the load and skip any grind.	
Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	3	8	90 sec	8	Upper-back support for turnover and jerk recovery; strict squeeze each rep.	
Mon	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	3	10/side	60 sec	6-7	Trunk stiffness for receiving positions; finish fresh.
